$comment: The one source of plan tiers, limits, and prices. Read by the API (src/api/src/plans.ts), the dashboard, and the landing page. Prices are in paise (1 INR = 100 paise) and include 18% GST. Every paid price must keep a 30-40% margin under the cost model in src/api/src/pricing.ts (a test enforces it). See docs/billing/pricing.md.

plans.name: Free
plans.blurb: The local engine with the core strategies, any OpenAI-compatible or local model, and the dashboard.

plans.name: Pro
plans.blurb: PyRIT and garak strategies, MCP targets, evidence and transcript sync, the model leaderboard, and higher limits.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.blurb: Organizations, policy controls, audit logs, SSO, and compliance. Priced per contract.
